mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the chest and lower body was most worthwhile: it showed where the diaphragm sits and how separate routes pass between regions.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the second arm felt predictable and mostly repeated the first attachment.

surprise.text: The kidneys sitting toward the back of the upper abdomen helped me picture their location alongside the gut.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless, though the final combinations were the only offered actions, so they felt more like assembly than decisions.

continue.text: I might continue if another chapter explored how these connected systems work together; this chapter's mostly predictable fittings made me less curious about more assembly alone.
